preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[1 + (line.split()[0] == 'NOT')]) <= n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each input vertex index in the description is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(line.split()[0] in ['AND', 'OR', 'XOR', 'NOT', 'IN'] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each vertex type is one of 'AND', 'OR', 'XOR', 'NOT', or 'IN'.

preconditions.expression: all(int(line.split()[1]) in [0, 1] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == 'IN')
preconditions.description: Each input vertex value is either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == len([line for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == 'IN'])
postconditions.description: The output string length matches the number of input vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(char in ['0', '1'] for char in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output string contains only '0' and '1' characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join(str(1 - int(line.split()[1])) if line.split()[0] == 'IN' else '0' for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == 'IN')
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string represents the new output value if the corresponding input is flipped.
